collectible:1.text: Spaceship Parts are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto V. There are 50 devices scattered around San Andreas, which are claimed to have been dropped by a spaceship after it crashed. Omega, a hippie from the Grand Senora Desert who claims to have been abducted by said spaceship in the day it crashed, can be encountered in Grand Senora Desert by Franklin Clinton after the mission Fame or Shame.

collectible:2.text: Letter Scraps are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto V. In 1975, famous Vinewood starlet Leonora Johnson was brutally murdered, and her dismembered body was found at the Land Act Dam. Shortly after, Leonora's killer, sent a letter to Richards Majestic Productions founder David Richards, confessing his crime. The letter remained a secret until 2013.

collectible:3.text: The Epsilon Tract is a collection challenge that becomes available after completing the eighth and final Epsilon mission: Unknowing the Truth, regardless of the said mission's outcome. Michael will receive an e-mail, after completing the final Epsilon mission, from Marnie explaining that the tract collections are available, and clues to find them.

collectible:4.text: Nuclear Waste are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto V. According to an internet news article from Public Liberty Online after the mission Fame or Shame, the nuclear waste tanks were deposited into the ocean following a winter storm. The are a total of 30 Nuclear Waste barrels around San Andreas.

collectible:5.text: Submarine Pieces are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto V. There are 30 pieces of the submarine belonging to the late producer Frank Mathers, scattered around San Andreas, which the player must find and collect. These collectibles are tied to Abigail Mathers's Strangers and Freaks mission strand, unlocked after Blitz Play and the purchase of the Sonar Collections Dock in Paleto Cove.

collectible:6.text: A Peyote Plant is a collectible featured in the enhanced version of Grand Theft Auto V. It can be consumed by the player. Named after the real-life Peyote cactus which contains psychoactive properties, this plant seemingly has some sort of hallucinogenic effect on the protagonist's brain and body once taken.

collectible:7.text: Monkey Mosaics are exclusive collectibles in the enhanced version of Grand Theft Auto V. Players can access this content regardless of whether they are a returning player or not, although limited for non-returning players. After completing the mission Repossession, Franklin will receive a text message from Lamar saying that a street artist has been painting monkey mosaics in walls across Los Santos.

collectible:8.page: Unique Stunt Jumps in GTA Vice City
collectible:8.text: Stunt Jumps are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. There are 36 jumps located around Vice City. Each completed stunt jump earns the player a reward of $100 multiplied by the number of jumps completed (for the n-th jump, $100*n). The 36th jump earns the player $10,000. Additional Insane Stunt Bonus payments can also be earned as the player completes each unique jump.

collectible:9.text: Under the Bridge is a miscellaneous challenge in Grand Theft Auto V. It requires the player to fly an aircraft or helicopter under 50 bridges around the game world to complete part of the "Close Shave" achievement/trophy. The player will also need to complete all 15 Knife Flight challenges in order to fully complete the "Close Shave" achievement/trophy.

collectible:10.text: Knife Flights are a miscellaneous challenge in Grand Theft Auto V. It requires the player to use a fixed-wing aircraft (helicopters can not perform a knife) and fly with the wings aligned vertically (a.k.a. knife) in between 15 sets of buildings around the game world to complete part the "Close Shave" achievement/trophy.

easter-egg:1.text: The Alien Egg is an item appearing in Grand Theft Auto Online as part of the Gunrunning update. The Alien Egg is a type of supply item to be stolen and stored at a player-owned Bunker. Stealing the Alien Egg is a requirement to unlock the "???" tattoo introduced in the Arena War update. In order to obtain the item, the player must complete at least 600 resupply missions for the Bunker.

easter-egg:4.text: The Spinning Anus is a static prop vehicle appearing in Grand Theft Auto V. It is depicted as a flying saucer-type UFO, designed specifically as a cutscene object for the mission Did Somebody Say Yoga?, in which this UFO abducts Michael De Santa during an anesthetic-induced dream. The UFO has FIB markings on it. The UFO projects a powerful light beam from a circular hatch to abduct Michael.

easter-egg:5.text: Jolene Cranley-Evans, referred to as The Ghost of Mount Gordo, is a minor character in Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online. Jolene is the deceased wife of politician and former actor and stuntman Jock Cranley. She was born in 1956, before the date of March 24th. At some point before 1978, she met and married stuntman John "Jock" Cranley.

easter-egg:6.text: The Beast is a creature introduced in the Freemode Events Update in Grand Theft Auto Online, and in Grand Theft Auto V for the PS4, Xbox One, and PC versions of the game. The appearance of the Beast would appear to be based on that of Michael J. Fox's werewolf character in the 1985 film Teen Wolf.

easter-egg:8.text: Chupacabra Street is a street in Elysian Island, Los Santos, that appears in Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online. It begins and ends at Plaice Place. It is possibly based on Barracuda Street, San Pedro, Los Angeles.

easter-egg:9.text: Before the release of Grand Theft Auto V, there were features that were removed from the final product. These changes range from deleted vehicles and player skins to the removal of entire characters and mission strands. Various mission changes were made to the game before its initial release.

easter-egg:10.text: Big O Fruit Juice is a fresh juice business featured in Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online. Juice stands of this business can be found at the Arthur's Pass Trails in Great Chaparral and on the intersection of East Joshua Road and Senora Freeway near Grapeseed. The juice stands have a big orange ball at the top, which can be detached if the player shoots, kicks or simply touches it.

easter-egg:12.text: The Canis Bodhi (pronounced as Boh-dee) is a two-door pickup appearing in Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online. The Bodhi resembles a Kaiser Jeep M715, as the Bodhi's doors, rollcage, and other parts are similar to its real-life counterpart.

easter-egg:16.text: Mount Chiliad is one of three named mountains in Blaine County, San Andreas in Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online, the others being Mount Josiah and Mount Gordo. Mount Chiliad is the tallest peak in the state. Located far to the north, in the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness, it serves as the tallest mountain in the game at 2774m  above sea level. Two small towns sit at its base.

easter-egg:19.text: Hot Wheels is a mission in Grand Theft Auto Advance given to protagonist Mike by his associate Vinnie from Momma's Restaurante in Saint Mark's (mislabelled as Portland Beach), Portland, Liberty City. At Momma's Restaurante, Vinnie informs Mike that the Mafia have agreed to help them leave Liberty City. However, they need a fast car and one is waiting to be taken in Atlantic Quays.

easter-egg:20.text: Hunting is a side-activity featured in Grand Theft Auto V. It can only be accessed by Trevor Philips between 5:00 and 19:00. The hunting activity appears to be based on the one featured in the 2010 open-world western Red Dead Redemption, another game made by Rockstar Games. The hunting activity takes place in a single location in Blaine County, the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness.

easter-egg:22.text: Mount Chiliad is one of three named mountains in Blaine County, San Andreas in Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online, the others being Mount Josiah and Mount Gordo. Mount Chiliad is the tallest peak in the state. Located far to the north, in the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness, it serves as the tallest mountain in the game at 2774m  above sea level. Two small towns sit at its base.

easter-egg:24.text: Rusty Brown's Ring Donuts is a donut and coffee shop appearing in the HD Universe of the Grand Theft Auto series. According to their website, the business is nearly 50 years old by 2008. It has expanded into the internet, selling donuts online, and recently opened the franchise in East Asia. Its main site is at www.rustybrownsringdonuts.com. Rusty Brown's has a theme for the cell phone at www.vipluxuryringtones.com.

easter-egg:25.text: Rockstar North is the trade name of Rockstar Games UK Limited (formerly known as DMA Design Limited and Rockstar North Limited), a British video game development company from Edinburgh, Scotland, originally founded in Dundee in 1987 by David Scott Jones, soon hiring former classmates Mike Dailly, Russell Kay, and Steve Hammond.

easter-egg:26.text: The Snowman is an easter egg in Grand Theft Auto V. It can be found in the Fridgit factory in Cypress Flats, Los Santos. If the player enters the company's warehouse, he may notice one of the large metal doors is partially opened. If the player looks through the crack between the doors, he will be able to see a large snowman inside the room, wearing a cap and a scarf, with his mouth set in a comical grin.

easter-egg:29.text: Wrecks are heavily damaged vehicles appearing in the Grand Theft Auto series. While wrecks may sometimes be classified as controllable (but usually unobtainable) vehicles, they are generally static props and cannot be used or operated by the player.
